_comment: Nest's CreateX instance. Deployed on every Nest chain through the Arachnid deterministic CREATE2 factory with this salt and init code, so the same address is reproducible on any chain where the factory exists. Init code (16,240 bytes) lives in initcode.hex; keccak256 must equal initCodeHash. Reference deployment: Plume tx 0xae7c687d648cdf254548236ddcfd9ff135eff1c2998a18de52e00942302711fd.
